longDescription: The glockenspiel is a fascinating historical instrument. Discover in the AR experience how the mechanics work and listen to the traditional melodies.
arPermissionDescription: This app needs access to motion and orientation so the gyroscope controls work.
arStartDescription: Tap OK to start the glockenspiel AR experience.
arStartErrorFallback: The AR view could not be started.
quizQuestion: How many bells does the glockenspiel have?
